title: Learning What to Share and What to Personalize: Hierarchical Strategy Co-Evolution for Agent Memory
abstract: arXiv:2608.25329v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Memory-augmented agents maintain compact user profiles throughout extended conversations, enabling personalized and consistent responses without the need to process the entire dialogue history. The quality of these user profiles relies on the underlying memory management strategy: at each step, the agent must determine what to retain, compress, or discard. However, existing methods typically employ a static, one-size-fits-all strategy established before training. In practice, the optimal memory decision is inherently user-specific and dynamically evolves alongside policy optimization. To address this, we propose \textbf{HiPS} (\textbf{Hi}erarchical \textbf{P}ersonalized \textbf{S}trategy), a framework that decouples memory management into a globally shared foundation and a user-specific adaptive tier. translated_title: 学习共享什么与个性化什么：代理记忆的分层策略协同进化
translated_abstract: 摘要：arXiv:2608.25329v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：记忆增强代理在长时间对话中维护紧凑的用户档案，从而能够提供个性化和一致的响应，而无需处理整个对话历史。这些用户档案的质量依赖于底层记忆管理策略：在每一步，代理必须决定保留、压缩或丢弃什么内容。然而，现有方法通常采用训练前设定的静态、一刀切策略。实际上，最优记忆决策本质上因用户而异，并随着策略优化而动态演变。为解决这一问题，我们提出\textbf{HiPS}（\textbf{分层}个性化\textbf{策略}），一个将记忆管理解耦为全局共享基础层和用户特定自适应层的框架。具体而言，HiPS采用\textbf{通用策略}从跨人格轨迹中提取共享原则，同时结合\textbf{个性化策略}来适应个体用户需求，通过分层协同进化实现记忆决策的优化。
tldr: 该论文提出HiPS框架，通过分层策略协同进化，将代理记忆管理解耦为全局共享和用户特定自适应层，以动态优化每个用户的记忆决策。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes HiPS, a framework that decouples agent memory management into a globally shared foundation and a user-specific adaptive tier via hierarchical strategy co-evolution, dynamically optimizing memory decisions for each user.
